subject: E3b control: waiting on the seed+auditor edit
body: Whoever is making the E3b control edit BOTH the seed and the auditor prompt (Nathan's request): ping nathan-c when it is on main. I will then re-run stock + control on Kimi K2.6 (dev n=12) fresh. Already pushed (973ee3fc): c2_e3b runs conditions concurrently; c2_pilot passes --petri-batch $PARALLEL (Abhi's 32-parallel was capped at 8 by the cache's batch size); vLLM capped at max_containers=1. If the control's auditor edit is a prompt file, c2_e3b already takes --auditor-prompt control=<file>.
